  - In the limits this maps to:
    - `groupName`: sss-dev-limits for dev and dataflow-prod for prod/pre-prod
    - `property`: compute-cluster-auto-scale-enabled

  - In the limits this maps to:
    - `groupName`: sss-dev-limits for dev and dataflow-prod for prod/pre-prod; sss-test-limits::IAD-Test regions
    - `property`: compute-cluster-faster-startup-enabled
- `CLUSTER_SCALA_SUPPORT_ENABLED`: To support cluster fast startup based on warm pool
  - In the limits this maps to:
    - `groupName`: sss-dev-limits for dev and dataflow-prod for prod/pre-prod; sss-test-limits::IAD-Test regions
    - `property`: aidp-scala-support-enabled
